steps.detail: goes away everywhere it is not set on by a folder or project: 3 skills (arch-review, debug-loop, release-notes), 2 agents (code-reviewer, planner), 2 commands (plan, review), 23 hook handlers, 2 MCP servers (plugin:ecc:chrome-devtools, plugin:ecc:memory)
stays: your own skills, agents, commands and hooks, every other plugin and the servers behind the Toolport gateway

plan.summary: Disable ecc@ecc for every project (user scope)
warnings: This turns ecc@ecc off for every project on this machine and for every folder that has no setting of its own; a folder or project that sets it itself keeps its own value
Claude Code reads plugin settings when a session starts: sessions that are already running keep the old state until they restart
